entities.summary: Ruslan Iskhakov is a Russian professional ice hockey forward for Metallurg Magnitogorsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected in the second round, 43rd overall, by the New York Islanders in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
